column1: # hook point | arguments it gets | when it runs
theme-set|THEME|after a theme or accent was applied (carpatic theme set, the Settings app, the menu)
theme-import|THEME|after a theme pack or Omarchy theme was imported
theme-export|THEME FILE|after a theme pack was made
wallpaper-set|FILE|after the wallpaper changed (carpatic theme wallpaper, Super+Ctrl+Space)
font-set|FONT|after fonts or icons changed (carpatic appearance)
post-update|-|after carpatic update apply finished well
screenshot|FILE|after a screenshot was saved (carpatic trigger screenshot)
recording-stop|FILE|after a screen recording was saved
webapp-add|NAME URL|after a web app was added
dev-install|NAME|after a dev environment was installed
login|-|at the start of every desktop session
dotfiles-sync|-|after your settings were pushed to your repository
